finding.claim: Unauthenticated insecure deserialization: Marshal.load on attacker-supplied base64 data in POST /restore allows remote code execution via a gadget chain.
finding.source: params[:state] (POST /restore form/query parameter), attacker-controlled, no authentication

trace.note: POST /restore route defined with no auth guard
params[:state] base64-decoded and passed directly to Marshal.load
result inspected and returned, but deserialization side effects/gadgets already executed

finding.guards_checked: No authentication, signature/HMAC, or class allowlist on the data; no before filter or middleware in the file; Marshal.load is not a safe loader. Any remote client can reach the route.

verdict.reason: app.rb:6 passes Base64.decode64(params[:state]) straight into Marshal.load in the unauthenticated Sinatra route at app.rb:5; app.rb is the only file, so there is no auth, HMAC, allowlist or middleware, and an anonymous attacker can reach it.
